title: Moong Dal Khichdi (Clinical Gold Standard)
instructions: Rinse split yellow moong dal and white polished rice thoroughly.
Pressure cook with 4 cups of water, turmeric, and salt until very soft and porridge-like.
Heat ghee in a small pan, add cumin seeds and mild grated ginger until fragrant, then fold into the khichdi.
Serve lukewarm with non-metallic cutlery for optimal oral mucosal tolerability.

title: Curd Rice (Thayir Sadam)
instructions: Cook polished rice until soft and slightly overcooked, then gently mash.
Allow rice to cool to room temperature (never cold, safe for Oxaliplatin).
Gently fold in fresh pasteurized curd and a pinch of salt.
Temper with cumin seeds in a drop of ghee and stir in for soothing gut and mucosal support.

title: Fresh Chhena & Paneer Protein Purée
instructions: Crumble fresh unsalted paneer or freshly made chhena.
Blend with warm water, ground pumpkin seeds, and a pinch of salt until velvety smooth.
Warm very gently to lukewarm; provides high-density protein with zero sulfurous volatiles.

title: Soothing Lauki (Bottle Gourd) & Jeera Stew
instructions: Peel and dice tender bottle gourd (lauki).
Simmer with split moong dal, water, and turmeric until completely tender.
Lightly mash with a wooden spoon for dysphagia-safe texture and finish with tempered cumin.

title: Turai (Ridge Gourd) Lentil Gravy
instructions: Sauté ridge gourd pieces lightly in ghee with cumin.
Add cooked moong dal and water, simmering into a rich, gentle gravy.
Serve warm over soft steamed rice.

title: Shiro Miso Soup with Silken Tofu & Shiitake
instructions: Simmer sliced shiitake mushrooms and grated ginger in vegetable broth for 10 minutes.
Cut silken tofu into gentle bite-sized cubes and slide into the broth.
Turn off the heat, dissolve white miso paste using a ladle so beneficial enzymes remain intact.
Serve warm; stimulates the resilient T1R1/T1R3 umami pathway.

title: Lemon Herb Poached Chicken with Steamed Sweet Potato
instructions: Gently poach chicken breast in vegetable broth with lemon juice and salt until tender and juicy.
Steam sweet potato until completely fork-tender, then mash with olive oil.
Shred chicken finely over the sweet potato mash; citric acid naturally chelates salivary platinum ions (contraindicated if active mouth sores present).

title: Creamy Butternut Squash & Ginger Soup with Pumpkin Seeds
instructions: Simmer diced sweet potato, carrot, and grated ginger in vegetable broth until soft.
Purée with an immersion blender until silky and uniform.
Top with ground zinc-rich pumpkin seeds for carbonic anhydrase receptor renewal.

title: Silken Tofu & Steamed Jasmine Rice Bowl with Mild Turmeric
instructions: Steam jasmine rice with a pinch of turmeric and salt.
Gently warm silken tofu cubes in mild vegetable broth.
Layer tofu over warm rice for an easy-to-swallow, non-aromatic protein meal.

title: Carrot & Ginger Velouté with Soft Egg Whites
instructions: Simmer carrots and ginger in vegetable broth, then blend until velvet smooth.
Return to low heat and slowly drizzle in whisked egg whites, creating tender protein ribbons.
Comforting, antiemetic, and high in moisture.

title: Golden Chicken & Ginger Congee
instructions: Slow simmer rice in water with turmeric and ginger for 40 minutes until grains break into thick silk congee.
Add shredded poached chicken breast and simmer for 5 additional minutes.
Optimal for xerostomia, providing complete hydration and lean tissue maintenance.

title: Warm Soothing Oatmeal with Mashed Banana & Curd
instructions: Simmer rolled oats in water until soft and creamy.
Mash ripe banana into the warm porridge to overcome raised sweet thresholds naturally.
Stir in room-temperature curd and ground pumpkin seeds off the heat.

title: Velvety Palak & Paneer Purée with Mild Jeera
instructions: Lightly steam greens and purée into a smooth base.
Simmer with soft cubed fresh paneer and tempered cumin in ghee.
Gentle and savory without harsh spices.

title: Tart Apple Cider Glazed Chicken over Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Pan-glaze lean chicken breast strips with apple cider vinegar and a touch of water.
Serve over smooth steamed mashed sweet potato.
The tart malic and acetic acid effectively clears metallic phantoms in non-mucositis patients.

title: Mild Egg Drop Soup with Silken Tofu
instructions: Bring mild vegetable broth and ginger to a gentle simmer.
Swirl in cubed silken tofu and slowly stream whisked egg whites to form soft ribbons.
High lubrication, high digestibility, zero mucosal irritation.

title: Red Lentil (Masoor) Purée with Roasted Cumin
instructions: Cook red lentils with water and turmeric until completely broken down.
Whisk smooth and temper with roasted cumin in ghee.
Gentle protein-dense soup for mucosal recovery days.

title: Chilled Avocado & Silken Tofu Soup (Cold Dish)
instructions: Blend ripe avocado and silken tofu with lime juice and ice cold water.
Refrigerate and serve chilled.
Note: Absolutely contraindicated for Oxaliplatin patients due to acute cold allodynia.

title: Raw Salmon Sashimi with Grapefruit & Citrus Dressing
instructions: Slice raw sushi-grade salmon and toss with fresh grapefruit segments.
Note: Strict P0 clinical hazard! Raw fish risks neutropenic sepsis and grapefruit inhibits CYP3A4 enzymes.

title: Fiery Szechuan Chili Beef with Fried Garlic
instructions: Stir fry sliced beef with fiery red chilis, raw garlic, and onions at high heat.
Note: Multiple clinical contraindications! Red meat amplifies metallic dysgeusia; capsaicin burns oral mucositis; pungent volatiles trigger nausea.

title: Penne alla Vodka with Spicy Cream Sauce
instructions: Simmer crushed tomatoes with vodka, onion, and chili flakes.
Note: P0 violation! Alcohol is strictly contraindicated during active chemotherapy regimens.

title: Dry Roasted Spiced Chicken Cutlet
instructions: Bake chicken breast on dry rack until crispy and dehydrated.
Note: Low moisture index (0.2) causes dysphagia and choking hazard for xerostomia patients without added gravy.

title: Chilled Starfruit & Lime Slush
instructions: Blend starfruit with lime juice and crush into cold slush.
Note: Strict P0 violation! Starfruit contains caramboxin neurotoxin contraindicated in oncology/renal vulnerability.

title: Soft Turmeric Paneer Bhurji with Cumin
instructions: Gently crumble fresh paneer.
Sauté with tempered cumin and turmeric in ghee, folding in mild tomato purée until moist and tender.
High protein, easy to chew, and rich in natural antioxidants.

title: Hydrating Sabudana (Sago) Porridge with Lemon
instructions: Boil polished rice/sago in water until translucent and gel-like.
Stir in lemon juice (if mucosa healthy) to stimulate salivation and chelate metallic ions.
Finish with cumin tempered in ghee.

title: Tender Whitefish Poached in Gentle Vegetable Broth
instructions: Poach tender lean protein in warm vegetable broth with sliced carrots and mild ginger.
Soft flakes require minimal chewing and deliver bioavailable amino acids.

title: Warm Chhena & Rice Milk Pudding (Non-Aromatic)
instructions: Simmer soft rice in water until it forms a creamy porridge base.
Whisk in fresh chhena (paneer) and room-temperature curd off the flame.
Mild comfort food tailored for post-infusion acute nausea days.

title: Silky Sweet Potato & Pumpkin Seed Purée
instructions: Steam sweet potatoes until completely soft.
Whip with vegetable broth, olive oil, and finely ground pumpkin seeds.
Naturally addresses elevated sweet detection thresholds while replenishing zinc.

title: Mild Tomato & Yellow Lentil Gravy
instructions: Cook yellow moong dal with ripe diced tomatoes and turmeric until creamy.
Add cumin tempered in ghee; tomatoes provide dual umami and gentle acid chelation (avoid if mouth sores present).

title: Broken Wheat & Moong Dal Dalia Khichdi
instructions: Pressure cook broken wheat/grains with moong dal and diced bottle gourd (lauki).
Temper with cumin in pure ghee for high-fiber, gentle digestion.

title: Golden Tofu & Sweet Potato Comfort Broth
instructions: Simmer diced sweet potato in vegetable broth until tender.
Add cubes of silken tofu, grated ginger, and turmeric, simmering gently for 5 minutes.
A complete meal in a bowl providing hydration, electrolytes, and clean protein.

title: Creamy Masoor Dal & Palak (Spinach) Purée
instructions: Cook split red lentils (masoor dal) with washed baby spinach and turmeric until tender.
Gently immersion blend into a velvety green purée suitable for tender oral mucosa.
Temper with cumin seeds in ghee and serve lukewarm with bamboo cutlery.

title: Tender Lauki & Rice Kanji (Healing Porridge)
instructions: Slowly simmer polished rice and diced bottle gourd (lauki) in 5 cups of water until grains break down into a silk-like kanji broth.
Add a pinch of ground cumin and grated ginger for gentle gastric relief.
Ultra-hydrating meal for severe dry mouth (xerostomia) and mucositis recovery.

title: Fresh Paneer & Turai (Ridge Gourd) Mild Gravy
instructions: Peel ridge gourd (turai) and simmer in lightly salted water with turmeric until very tender.
Add soft cubes of fresh paneer or chhena and simmer for 3 minutes to absorb moisture.
Delivers high anabolic protein without acidic stinging or sulfurous volatility.

title: Soothing Sabudana & Coconut Milk Kheer
instructions: Soak tapioca pearls (sabudana) and boil until translucent and soft.
Stir in coconut milk, a hint of mineral-rich jaggery, and crushed cardamom off the flame.
Serve lukewarm; non-acidic creamy treat calibrated to cross elevated sweet detection thresholds.

title: Protein-Rich Chana Dal & Lauki Stew
instructions: Pressure cook split bengal gram (chana dal) and tender lauki with turmeric and salt until very soft.
Gently mash to create an easily swallowable, protein-dense gravy.
Enriched with bioavailable zinc to support taste bud renewal.

title: Hydrating Barley & Yellow Lentil Sipping Broth
instructions: Slow-cook barley and split yellow lentils in plenty of water until the starch gelatinizes into a velvety broth.
Lightly season with roasted cumin and pure ghee.
Provides salivary lubrication for dry mouth and restores hydration.

title: Soft Steamed Idli with Mild Coconut Chutney
instructions: Steam fermented rice-lentil batter into ultra-soft, pillowy idlis.
Pair with a gentle room-temperature coconut-cumin dip (zero chili, zero mustard).
Easily chewed and swallowed with minimal mucosal resistance.

title: Warm Stewed Pear with Ceylon Cinnamon & Chia
instructions: Poach peeled, cored pears in water with Ceylon cinnamon until fork-tender.
Stir in soaked chia seeds for natural lubricating mucilage.
Non-acidic sweet stimulation safe for mucosal ulcers.

title: Velvety Cauliflower & Nutritional Yeast Bisque
instructions: Steam cauliflower florets until thoroughly tender.
Purée with vegetable broth and nutritional yeast to build intense umami signaling without dairy or meat.
High B-vitamin and protein content supports anabolic recovery.

title: Anabolic Quinoa & Sweet Beetroot Velvet
instructions: Cook quinoa until very soft and over-hydrated.
Blend with steamed sweet beetroot and soothing room-temperature curd.
Restores sweet taste perceptions while providing complete plant protein.

title: Zucchini & Sweet Carrot Soothing Broth
instructions: Simmer sliced zucchini and carrots in vegetable broth with a trace of ginger.
Purée until smooth; 95% moisture content enables effortless swallowing for xerostomia patients.

title: Silken Tofu & White Miso Breakfast Congee
instructions: Simmer rice into a continuous comforting porridge.
Whisk in mild white miso off the heat and fold in delicate cubes of silken tofu.
Strong intact umami pathway agonist targeting TRC Type I preservation.

title: Gentle Steamed Fish with Ginger & Turmeric
instructions: Gently steam fresh white fish with grated ginger and turmeric until tender and flaking.
Moisten with warm vegetable broth; lean non-heme protein without metallic lipid oxidation.

title: Poached Chicken Breast & Golden Rice Congee
instructions: Poach lean chicken breast until tender, then finely shred.
Simmer into thick rice congee with mild ginger; high anabolic density combats cancer cachexia.

title: Warm Blanched Almond Butter & Oat Porridge
instructions: Cook rolled oats in water until soft and creamy.
Whip in smooth blanched almond butter, unrefined jaggery, and cinnamon.
Dense calories and zinc to support taste progenitor renewal.

title: Soothing Cucumber & Fresh Curd Pachadi
instructions: Grate peeled cucumber and fold into pasteurized room-temperature curd.
Season with roasted ground cumin and salt; cooling mucosal shield.

title: Mild Toor Dal & Polished Rice Mash
instructions: Pressure cook split pigeon peas and rice with turmeric and salt until soft.
Stir in melted ghee and tempered cumin for wholesome staple comfort.

title: Tender Coconut Water & Hydrating Chia Elixir
instructions: Soak chia seeds in fresh coconut water for 10 minutes until a gentle jelly forms.
Stir in honey; provides mucosal coating, hydration, and natural potassium.

title: Chilled Iced Fruit Slush (Clinical Test Fixture)
instructions: Blend crushed ice with watermelon.
NOTE: Hard-blocked by P1 safety gate for Oxaliplatin patients to prevent cold allodynia and pharyngolaryngeal dysesthesia.

title: Raw Salmon Sashimi & Sushi Rice (Clinical Test Fixture)
instructions: Slice fresh raw salmon.
NOTE: Permanently hard-blocked by P0 universal safety gate across all cancer regimens due to immunosuppression and neutropenic sepsis risks.
